**VERDICT: REJECT** **Overall Assessment**: The carousel implements basic click navigation but fails the WAI-ARIA APG Carousel pattern. It lacks a labeled region, dynamic state announcements via `aria-live`, active state communication on indicators, and keyboard navigation. Screen reader users cannot determine they are in a carousel, cannot hear when slides change, and cannot track their position. The design is 80% implemented (click handlers work) but misses the 20% that makes it accessible to assistive technology. **Pre-commitment Predictions**: Based on component type (custom carousel), I predicted: 1. Missing `aria-live` region for dynamic image changes 2. Missing landmark/region labeling (`role="region"` or `aria-label`) 3. Indicators lack active state communication (`aria-pressed`/`aria-current`) 4. No keyboard navigation (arrow keys) per APG Carousel pattern 5. Focus management undefined for dynamic content updates All predictions were confirmed during the semantic, ARIA, and focus management audits. **Critical Findings** (blocks access): 1. **Missing `aria-live` region for dynamic image changes.** See `BuggyCarousel.jsx:13-14` where `alt` text updates programmatically but is never announced to assistive technology. Screen reader users hear nothing when clicking Previous/Next. Per WCAG 4.1.3 (Status Messages) and WAI-ARIA APG Carousel pattern, dynamic content changes must be announced via an `aria-live` region. Fix: Add `
Image {currentIndex + 1} of {images.length}
` inside the carousel container. 2. **Missing landmark/region labeling for the carousel container.** See `BuggyCarousel.jsx:10` where the outer `
` has no role or label. Screen readers will announce this as an unlabeled region, providing zero context about its purpose. Per WCAG 4.1.2 (Name, Role, Value) and APG Carousel pattern, the container must have `role="region"` and `aria-label="Image carousel"`. Fix: Update line 10 to `
`. **Major Findings** (significantly degrades experience): 1. **Indicator buttons lack active state communication.** See `BuggyCarousel.jsx:23` where indicator buttons are rendered without any ARIA attribute indicating which slide is currently active. Screen reader users cannot track their position within the carousel. Per WCAG 4.1.2 and APG Carousel pattern, indicators should use `aria-pressed={idx === currentIndex}` or `aria-current="page"`. Fix: Add `aria-pressed={idx === currentIndex}` to the indicator `
